sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven mature face in three-quarter view toward screen right, short side-parted sandy blond hair, darker grey-brown separate eyebrows and tight closed serious mouth. Dark navy jacket with thin light lapel edging over white pointed shirt and folded blue bow tie. No hat, eyewear or lapel pin visible in this variant. Preserve shoulder/chest crop, actual head direction, upper-left illumination and full pale cream-grey painted backing; tiny bow/fabric and hair texture is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven mature face in three-quarter view toward screen right, short side-parted sandy blond hair and clear grey-brown eyebrows, tight closed serious mouth, no hat/eyewear. Dark charcoal/black piped jacket with small dark shoulder-strap shapes near cropped shoulders, white pointed shirt and long burgundy/red conventional necktie. Preserve this actual necktie clothing, crop, gaze and soft upper-left light on complete cream-grey painted backing. Exact tiny shoulder fastening and fabric stitches cannot be resolved; do not invent badges.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven mature face toward screen right, short sandy blond temple hair below tall olive peaked cap, separate darker eyebrows and serious closed mouth. Cap has narrow gold edging, black visor, gold cord and lower gold wreath/central small roundel, plus a separate small gold spread-wing bird emblem high on front. Dark olive closed tunic has black upper collar, red collar patches with gold leaf groups, gold/red shoulder boards and a small central throat badge above a partly cropped black-white cross-shaped decoration. Preserve actual clothing, crop, right-facing angle, upper-left light and complete pale grey-beige backing; tiny insignia engraving is unreadable beyond visible groups.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older near-frontal/three-quarter face turned toward screen right with slightly raised gaze; short grey-brown temple hair mostly under tall olive peaked cap, light grey-brown brows, small closed serious mouth and smooth chin. One round metal monocle surrounds the screen-left eye only; do not add a second lens or full spectacles. Cap retains gold piping/cord, black visor, gold lower wreath/central roundel and separate high gold bird emblem. Olive tunic with black upper collar, red gold-leaf collar tabs, gold/red shoulder boards and small central throat badge above partly cropped black-white cross decoration. Full chest-up crop/backing and soft upper-left light retained; tiny upper-lip shading and cap/tab microtexture are not a reason to invent facial hair or extra emblems.
